scope: Shared observed-object template applicability and partial geometry; no actor, frozen-source edit, or manuscript edit.

code_findings.finding: track0 participates in measured_groups; each eligible component gets full box/shelf pair and object_probability defaults1. SemanticFalse also preserves this default.
Full quadrature corrects the cap/history confound; geometry/free toggles do not correct template applicability to unassigned background fragments.
Pooling only joins track>0; track0 unchanged. Z may remain1 for unrefuted unassigned hypotheses while penalizing misfitted true objects.
owner map maps visible categories2/3 to labels1/2. Current one-shelf/one-cabinet scene supports this controlled use, but same-category multi-instance separation is not established.
Associations use sampled measured voxel overlap; track IDs are not true object identity. Ambiguous overlaps create unassigned support.

minimal_method.object_domain: Construct furniture completion hypotheses only for acquired track>0 support, shared by G/S. Keep track0 as unassociated geometry, not asserted background or unreachable space.
minimal_method.unchanged_roles: All measured points remain in TSDF, coverage, measured-surface quality and collision/execution representations. No navigation candidate is removed by this object-template eligibility.
minimal_method.pooling: One unique acquired support union pertrack. Retain historical P baseline to separate pooling from new template-domain restriction.
minimal_method.G_definition: Instance-aware geometry baseline with the same ideal visible object masks as S and neutral .5 category prior. Do not call it pure no-semantics geometry.
minimal_method.S_definition: Same tracks, clouds, fitted dimensions, quadrature, likelihood and history. Only the fine open/closed prior changes.
minimal_method.null_meaning: No furniture template for unassociated support is absence of model support, not geometric absence or evidence of background.
minimal_method.required_disclosure: This changes the research reward model domain, not merely engineering. Current ideal labels/object masks are oracle sensor inputs restricted to visible valid-depth pixels; no source bounds or hidden geometry enters the actor.
minimal_method.geometry: Fit candidate shape/pose using only acquired clouds/normals and acquired valid-depth free-space constraints, with unobserved extents retaining explicit priors/uncertainty. Do not use the full source asset, evaluator distance, unknown max extent or per-object truth-sized bounds.
minimal_method.geometry_trap: Observed tangential span is a lower bound; unconstrained nearest-neighbor fitting to a partial front face can collapse thickness. Internal shelf planes are not necessarily outer extent planes.
minimal_method.no_new_Z: Do not couple a new absolute confidence discount to the first object-domain and geometry tests; V2 Z failed and would confound cause.

pre_registration.inputs: Same original B S prefixes left24/54/109 andright24/53/110, exact packets/poses/owners and byte-identical prefix native meshes. All66 old fixed outbound branches retained without re-execution.
pre_registration.variants: Retain old F andP predictions; new O=pooled observed tracks only with inherited template fit; OF=O plus declared measured-data partial shape fit. If pooling itself changes again, give that another explicit ablation.
fairness_checks: Swap/neutralize category scores while holding masks fixed: admitted point/track set and all fitted geometry/hypothesis samples identical up to track renaming.
Initial absence of object masks must leave all common coverage/quality terms and candidates unchanged, with no fabricated furniture surface.
Same-class duplicate objects and ambiguous track associations must be disclosed as unsupported by the current owner adapter, not silently treated as oneobject.
Log all admitted/unadmitted groups, support counts, frame provenance, and inherited eligibility exclusions.
primary_metrics: Within each state, candidate-wise absolute source-supported predicted weight and realized source-supported previously-unmatched weight, not merely supportfraction.
Separate open31/closed118 actual before/after native-TSDF recall and gross/lost/net source-area increments using the frozen reference.
Template-only rank association against each actual object and their summed actual new surface; report undefined ranks for constant predictions.
Unchanged full-score selected candidate actual object/global surface change, coverage change, actions andpath; G/S disagreement alone is not benefit.
object_retention: Report observed true-object admission recall over currently visible/associated valid support, including no-hypothesis and size-exclusion counts. Denominator cannot exclude a visible object because the newmethod failed to model it.
Report per-object absolute predicted/realized weights and selectedactual reconstruction recall. High global supportfraction is insufficient when actualobject contribution collapses.

For optional shape-representation recall, source samples must be matched to complete hypothesis triangles at5cm, not sparsely spaced template quadrature points (up to22cm). Report before-unmatched realobject area coverage separately; do not call a mesh-union representation metric candidatevisibility or realized area.
pre_registration.aggregation: Candidate summaries/ranks within eachstate, then equal6state summary; preserve allstate/layout outcomes. These development states are dependent and not held-out validation or independent66samples.
pre_registration.promotion: Require improved object-supported prediction/rank plus no systematic loss of modeled observed objects or actual selected object recovery. Expose globalcoverage/cost tradeoffs; decline promotion if only smaller totalweight or higherprecision changes. Do not retune coefficients to forceS superiority.
pre_registration.heldout_limit: Any stage selection uses already-inspected development data. A later complete paired run is needed for policy effects; more diverse held-out scenes would be needed for generalization.
